'''2005 Norwegian National Championship Thomas Caspersen DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Caspersen]] at [[2005 Norwegian National Championship]], finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Thomas "Gaurhir" Caspersen (2005-05-06).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34752 Norwegian Nationals 1st Place (Dark Side)]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050525170925/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34752&PHPSESSID=...328fedb22570524062aeb1303 Internet Archive]</ref>
